name: Husqvarna 592 XP
blurb: 20″–36″ bars on 3/8″ chain, .050″ and .058″ and .063″ gauge, 72–115 drive links, from Husqvarna's 2027 bar and chain fit-up guide.
intro: The 592 XP is a professional rear-handle saw. Husqvarna's Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027) lists 27 bar and chain combinations for the 592 XP: 20″, 24″, 28″, 32″, 36″. Pitch on those rows: 3/8″. Gauge: .050″ and .058″ and .063″. More than one gauge is approved, so the groove stamped on the bar decides the chain. Where the file column reads Square, the chain is square-ground and the guide does not give a round-file diameter. 2 combinations are flagged because a part number in that cell does not agree with the rest of the row. Those are not verified loops. Match pitch, gauge and drive links to the bar-tail stamp before you order.
